title: Study on the spectrum-effect correlation of phytoestrogenic activity of total flavonoids from Cynomorii Herba.
authors: Xu, Hao-Dong; Wang, Tian-Yu; Wang, Chao; Meng, Zhuo-Yi; Chen, Jie-Lin; Zhou, Tong; Wang, Li-Hong; Zhao, Ji
one_liner_zh: 该文研究锁阳总黄酮的植物雌激素活性，通过指纹图谱与药效关联及分子对接验证化合物与雌激素受体结合，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Cynomorii Herba (CH), a traditional Chinese medicine, contains total flavonoids with potential phytoestrogenic activity, but the specific active components and mechanisms of action remain unclear. AIM OF THE STUDY: To investigate the active components and mechanisms responsible for the phytoestrogenic activity of Cynomorii Herba Total Flavonoids (CHTF). MATERIALS AND METHODS: A comprehensive fingerprint analysis of CHTF from 12 different regions was conducted using ultra-performance liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (UPLC-MS) technology. A spectrum-effect relationship model was established using grey relational analysis (GRA) and artificial neural network (ANN) methods, correlating the fingerprint peaks of CHTF with three pharmacological indicators: uterine index, MCF-7 cell proliferation rate, and estradiol (E2) content. Ultimately, molecular docking techniques were employed to verify the binding affinity of key flavonoid compounds to estrogen receptors (ER). RESULTS: The sample from Alxa Left Banner (AQ), showed the strongest activity. A comprehensive analysis identified 16 key components closely related to phytoestrogenic activity, with (+)-catechin, procyanidin C1, and (-)-epicatechin being the main active constituents. Molecular docking studies showed that these compounds have good binding affinity to ERalpha and ERbeta, confirming them as the main active substances responsible for the phytoestrogenic activity of CHTF. CONCLUSION: CHTF exhibits significant phytoestrogenic activity by mediating ER, and CHTF from different regions shows various degrees of phytoestrogenic activity. There are 9 flavonoid and 7 non-flavonoid compounds in CHTF responsible for its phytoestrogenic activity.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：锁阳（Cynomorii Herba, CH）作为一种传统中药，含有具有潜在植物雌激素活性的总黄酮，但其具体活性成分和作用机制尚不明确。研究目的：探讨锁阳总黄酮（Cynomorii Herba Total Flavonoids, CHTF）植物雌激素活性的活性成分及其作用机制。材料与方法：采用超高效液相色谱-质谱联用技术（UPLC-MS）对来自12个不同地区的CHTF进行了全面的指纹图谱分析。利用灰色关联分析（GRA）和人工神经网络（ANN）方法建立了谱效关系模型，将CHTF的指纹峰与三个药理学指标（子宫指数、MCF-7细胞增殖率和雌二醇（E2）含量）相关联。最终，采用分子对接技术验证了关键黄酮类化合物与雌激素受体（ER）的结合亲和力。结果：来自阿拉善左旗（AQ）的样品显示出最强的活性。综合分析确定了16个与植物雌激素活性密切相关的关键成分，其中(+)-儿茶素、原花青素C1和(-)-表儿茶素是主要活性成分。分子对接研究表明，这些化合物对ERα和ERβ具有良好的结合亲和力，证实它们是CHTF植物雌激素活性的主要活性物质。结论：CHTF通过介导ER表现出显著的植物雌激素活性，且不同地区的CHTF显示出不同程度的植物雌激素活性。CHTF中有9种黄酮类化合物和7种非黄酮类化合物负责其植物雌激素活性。
